original.question: Aagga qolka jiifka ee muraabac ee Cabdi waa 360 khubarada cagaha. Haddii dhererka qolku yahay 3 yard, waa maxay wareegga qolka oo cagaha ah?
original.answer:
Dhererka qolku waa 3 yard * (3 cagaha / 1 yard) = <<3*(3/1)=9>>9 cagaha.
Ballaadhka qolku waa 360 khubarada cagaha / 9 cagaha = <<360/9=40>>40 cagaha.
Wareegga qolku waa 2(40+9) = 98 cagaha
